CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cf_user_guards_v1.advance_stamp()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at:=greatest(clock_timestamp(),OLD.updated_at+interval '1 microsecond'); RETURN NEW; END $function$

cf_user_guards_v1.require_admin().definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cf_user_guards_v1.require_admin()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT' OR TG_RELID NOT IN ('public.profiles'::regclass,'public.user_roles'::regclass) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_user_guard_context' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.user_roles r USING(user_id) WHERE p.ativo IS TRUE AND r.role='administrador') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'user_last_active_admin' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

platform_private.b2b_packaging_item_snap.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_packaging_item_snapshot_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- Snapshot de embalagem: no INSERT precisa casar com a embalagem/preço/unidade reais; depois é imutável
-- (cotação só pode mudar colunas de preço). Linhas legadas nunca ganham snapshot de embalagem por UPDATE.
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.packaging_id_snapshot IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.product_packagings k
                    JOIN public.product_sale_units s ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.owner_organization_id = k.owner_organization_id
                    JOIN public.catalogo_precos_embalagem c ON c.id = NEW.packaging_price_id_snapshot AND c.packaging_id = k.id
                         AND c.produto_id = k.product_id AND c.owner_organization_id = k.owner_organization_id
                   WHERE k.id = NEW.packaging_id_snapshot AND k.product_id = NEW.product_id
                     AND k.codigo = NEW.packaging_codigo_snapshot AND k.version = NEW.packaging_version_snapshot
                     AND k.peso_liquido_kg = NEW.packaging_peso_liquido_kg_snapshot
                     AND s.unidade_conteudo = NEW.packaging_unidade_conteudo_snapshot) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_PACKAGING_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF (NEW.packaging_id_snapshot, NEW.packaging_codigo_snapshot, NEW.packaging_version_snapshot, NEW.packaging_peso_liquido_kg_snapshot,
      NEW.packaging_unidade_conteudo_snapshot, NEW.packaging_price_id_snapshot)
     IS DISTINCT FROM
     (OLD.packaging_id_snapshot, OLD.packaging_codigo_snapshot, OLD.packaging_version_snapshot, OLD.packaging_peso_liquido_kg_snapshot,
      OLD.packaging_unidade_conteudo_snapshot, OLD.packaging_price_id_snapshot)
     OR (OLD.packaging_id_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.product_id, NEW.quantidade, NEW.unidade_medida, NEW.volume_ml, NEW.order_id)
          IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.product_id, OLD.quantidade, OLD.unidade_medida, OLD.volume_ml, OLD.order_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'B2B_PACKAGING_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

platform_private.catalog_owner_immutable.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_owner_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.owner_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.owner_organization_id OR NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_owner_immutable' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

platform_private.catalog_tenant_agree(uu.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_tenant_agree(p uuid[])
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v uuid[] := ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT x FROM unnest(p) x WHERE x IS NOT NULL);
BEGIN
  IF cardinality(v) > 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_chain_divergence' USING ERRCODE = '42501', DETAIL = array_to_string(v, ','); END IF;
  RETURN v[1];
END $function$

platform_private.catalogo_volumes_owner_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalogo_volumes_owner_consistent()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NEW.owner_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.owner_organization_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_owner_immutable' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  IF NEW.produto_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id = NEW.produto_id AND p.owner_organization_id = NEW.owner_organization_id)
     OR NEW.microrganismo_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE m.id = NEW.microrganismo_id AND m.owner_organization_id = NEW.owner_organization_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_catalog_cross_tenant_reference' USING ERRCODE = '42501', DETAIL = 'catalogo_volumes'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

platform_private.lab_assert_manufacturab.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.lab_assert_manufacturable__tenant_core(p_product_id uuid, p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable(p_product_id,p_microorganism_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'LAB_ITEM_NOT_MANUFACTURABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514',
      HINT='Somente produtos biológicos e microrganismos podem gerar fabricação laboratorial.';
  END IF;
END $function$

platform_private.lab_item_is_manufactura.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable__tenant_core(p_product_id uuid, p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    -- Duas referências na mesma linha são ambíguas e falham fechadas. Isso impede que
    -- um microrganismo válido transforme produto químico/fertilizante em fabricável.
    WHEN p_product_id IS NOT NULL AND p_microorganism_id IS NOT NULL THEN false
    WHEN p_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=p_product_id AND p.familia_catalogo='biologico')
    WHEN p_microorganism_id IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE m.id=p_microorganism_id)
    ELSE false END
$function$

platform_private.solid_mass_packaging_gu.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.solid_mass_packaging_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SOLID_MASS_PACKAGING_HISTORY' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  
  IF (NEW.product_id, NEW.owner_organization_id, NEW.codigo, NEW.peso_liquido_kg, NEW.version, NEW.valid_from)
     IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.product_id, OLD.owner_organization_id, OLD.codigo, OLD.peso_liquido_kg, OLD.version, OLD.valid_from)
     OR (OLD.ativo IS FALSE AND NEW.ativo IS TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.solid_pack_presentation_tx t
                                                                   WHERE t.txid = pg_catalog.txid_current())) THEN
    
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SOLID_MASS_PACKAGING_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

platform_private.solid_pack_presentation.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.solid_pack_presentation_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv WHERE cv.id = NEW.id AND cv.medida = 'embalagem'
                   AND cv.produto_id = NEW.product_id AND cv.owner_organization_id = NEW.owner_organization_id
                   AND cv.ativo IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.ativo) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRESENTATION_LINK_MISMATCH' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

platform_private.stock_envase_mutation_g.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.stock_envase_mutation_gate_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '3s'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_LEVEL<>'STATEMENT' OR TG_WHEN<>'BEFORE' OR TG_OP NOT IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE')
 OR TG_RELID NOT IN ('public.organizations'::regclass,'public.organization_subscriptions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_versions'::regclass,'public.saas_plan_version_features'::regclass,'public.saas_features'::regclass,'public.saas_modules'::regclass,'public.organization_feature_overrides'::regclass,'public.clientes'::regclass,'public.programacao_producao'::regclass,'public.ordens_servico'::regclass,'public.lotes'::regclass,'public.controle_qualidade'::regclass,'public.estoque_produto'::regclass) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ENVASE_GATE_CONTEXT_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Existing upstream RPCs can prelock business rows before their first DML.
 -- Never wait here while owning those rows: reject contention atomically instead
 -- of closing the singleton/business-row deadlock cycle.
 PERFORM 1 FROM cf_user_guards_v1.state WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOCK_GATE_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE='PT503'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$
